translation:
The computer society members were nice
enough to teach me all sorts of new things.

They're just trying to win you over and get
confidential SOS Brigade info!

I have no doubt about it. That's just
espionage 101.
But you can rest at ease.

As long as these eyes of mine stay vigilant,
they won't be able to just do as they please.
You should be more on guard as well, Mikuru.

Otherwise, sooner or later some bad people
will sweep you up.

I can't say for certain you won't—you're
cute, after all.

Not to mention, for some reason you seem like
you'd be easy to snatch.

Mikuru, if someone tells you they're gonna
give you candy, don't follow them, okay?
I'd never do something like that!
